why_this_changes_the_picture: the sub-object contains the SERVER's IP address, so this object is about the NETWORK CONNECTION rather than about loading map assets

so ui_state 5 is most plausibly the CONNECTING screen - which also explains the spinner: a connecting UI animates it
and the client would then be stuck at 'connected to 127.0.0.1 but the session is not established', not at 'loading the map'
